retrievalProfile.description: A high-impact modular layout using bold color-blocked rectangles and ultra-compressed sans-serif type to organize text and instructional diagrams.
excludeWhen: serif or script fonts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, grid-based composition featuring interlocking rectangular cells of varying sizes. Each cell contains either massive, vertically elongated typography, a photographic portrait, or technical diagrams. The color palette is vibrant and primary-driven, using flat fills to create a rhythmic, percussive visual structure.
coreVisualRelationships: Heavy verticality in type contrasting with horizontal grid lines
Primary color blocks (red, blue, yellow) against black and white fields
Integration of technical dance-step diagrams within a commercial layout
Scale hierarchy where the largest type defines the primary grid boundaries
coreInvariants: High-contrast black borders or gutters between modules

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Text dominates the upper two-thirds in large horizontal bands; diagrams and smaller modules occupy the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large-scale title text in the top half acts as the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-to-bottom scan, following the horizontal bands of text before settling on the detailed diagrams in the lower quadrants.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the design is 'packed' with information, using color blocks as a substitute for open space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (used for primary text and background blocks)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (used for gutters, borders, and secondary text blocks)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red, Royal Blue, and Deep Purple
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high contrast; colors are used at full strength to define modular boundaries.

letterConstructionRules: Flat-sided curves on rounded letters (O, D, C)
characterSpecificRedesigns: M and N have very narrow internal angles
R has a short, straight leg to maintain verticality
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scales of the same compressed sans-serif family to maintain modular consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the extreme vertical compression and heavy weight.
Provides the clean, modern sans-serif structure in a compressed format.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a modular grid of rectangles in red, blue, black, and white. Include a small grayscale portrait in one square and a technical diagram of footprints in another.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-compressed, bold white and black sans-serif text in uppercase, filling the remaining rectangular modules edge-to-edge.

verificationChecks: Is the grid strictly rectangular with visible black gutters?
Are the colors flat with no gradients?

adjustableVariables: Color palette (swap red/blue for other primaries)
postGenerationChecks: Check that no text is cut off by the grid borders.
Ensure the footprint icons are stylized and consistent.
Verify that the portrait is high-contrast grayscale.
Confirm the overall feel is 1960s commercial print.
recipe.reuseFormula: Modular Grid + Compressed Sans-Serif + Primary Color Blocking + Technical Diagrams = Mid-Century Instructional Style
